name: Libertarian Authoritarianism
notAnIdeology: The Wikipedia article is chiefly about the libertarian-authoritarian axis, a survey and political-science dimension (British Social Attitudes, Tilley), plus a loosely defined commentators' label (Brown, New Statesman, Jacobin) for blends of right-libertarianism and authoritarianism; it describes no single set of beliefs with its own texts or adherents, and the article itself is flagged as lacking focus.
